body:
Triage: `domain:ui`, type `Bug` (the block's registration prose advertises a caption association the code does not perform, and the picker has no accessible name — same defect class the platform already ruled on and fixed three times), → `pm:queue`.

Resolution guidance, inheriting the family's rulings rather than re-opening them:
- Follow the #3341 + #5735 shape: `htmlFor`/`id` pair against the `SelectTrigger` (a `button`, labelable — #3341's landed test reasoning transfers verbatim), wired **when `schema.id` exists** — matching the `element:text_input` sibling precedent. The `useId`-fallback alternative would diverge from #5735's just-landed answer to the same question on the complement block; if a dev measures a reason the picker genuinely needs an always-on name, report it rather than silently choosing differently.
- Pin the **resolution**, not the two attributes: the test asserts the label resolves to the combobox and the combobox's accessible name is the label (the failure mode #3341 documents is an association that looks wired and resolves to nothing).

Serial note: #5735/PR #5770 (sibling block, same file family) — land after it and re-check `record-picker.tsx` line anchors on the merged ref. Dedup on the card is done and controlled (form-renderer family all distinct surfaces). `Size/model suggestion:` S, sonnet/opus.

Also ran packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx (covers element:record_picker) -> `Test Files 1 passed (1)` / `Tests 200 passed (200)`, no new DOM leaks from the id/Label change. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` clean. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-control-bytes.mjs` all pass.
